crow-water.name: crow_water_thirst_0
crow-water.text: 乌鸦喝水。

crow-water.name: crow_water_thirst_1
crow-water.text: 夏天，一只乌鸦飞了很久，口渴极了。

crow-water.name: crow_water_search_0
crow-water.text: 它飞过树林，又来到一口井边。

crow-water.name: crow_water_search_1
crow-water.text: 井已经干了，乌鸦只好继续寻找。

crow-water.name: crow_water_discover_0
crow-water.text: 忽然，它看见树下放着一个陶罐。

crow-water.name: crow_water_discover_1
crow-water.text: 乌鸦凑近一看：里面真的有水！

crow-water.name: crow_water_reach_0
crow-water.text: 可是罐口太小，水面又太低。

crow-water.name: crow_water_reach_1
crow-water.text: 它伸长脖子，还是够不到水。

crow-water.name: crow_water_push_0
crow-water.text: 乌鸦想把陶罐推倒，让水流出来。

crow-water.name: crow_water_push_1
crow-water.text: 它用力推了推，陶罐却纹丝不动。

crow-water.name: crow_water_idea_0
crow-water.text: 乌鸦停下来，认真看了看四周。

crow-water.name: crow_water_idea_1
crow-water.text: 地上的小石子，让它有了一个主意。

crow-water.name: crow_water_test_0
crow-water.text: 它叼起一颗石子，放进陶罐。

crow-water.name: crow_water_test_1
crow-water.text: 咚！石子沉下去，水面升高了一点。

crow-water.name: crow_water_repeat_0
crow-water.text: 乌鸦一颗接一颗，把石子放进去。

crow-water.name: crow_water_repeat_1
crow-water.text: 石子越来越多，水面也越来越高。

crow-water.name: crow_water_drink_0
crow-water.text: 水终于升到了乌鸦够得着的地方。

crow-water.name: crow_water_drink_1
crow-water.text: 它低下头，痛痛快快地喝了起来。

crow-water.name: crow_water_moral_0
crow-water.text: 乌鸦解了渴，开心地继续上路。

crow-water.name: crow_water_moral_1
crow-water.text: 遇到困难，认真观察，动脑筋想办法。

turtle-rabbit.name: turtle_rabbit_rivalry_0
turtle-rabbit.text: 龟兔赛跑。

turtle-rabbit.name: turtle_rabbit_rivalry_1
turtle-rabbit.text: 兔子跑得很快，总爱嘲笑慢慢走的乌龟。

turtle-rabbit.name: turtle_rabbit_challenge_0
turtle-rabbit.text: 乌龟说：跑得快，不一定能赢。

turtle-rabbit.name: turtle_rabbit_challenge_1
turtle-rabbit.text: 不如我们比一比，看谁先到终点。

turtle-rabbit.name: turtle_rabbit_start_0
turtle-rabbit.text: 小动物们约好，山坡下的大树就是终点。

turtle-rabbit.name: turtle_rabbit_start_1
turtle-rabbit.text: 一声令下，兔子和乌龟一起出发。

turtle-rabbit.name: turtle_rabbit_lead_0
turtle-rabbit.text: 兔子跑得飞快，很快就遥遥领先。

turtle-rabbit.name: turtle_rabbit_lead_1
turtle-rabbit.text: 回头看时，乌龟还在远处慢慢走。

turtle-rabbit.name: turtle_rabbit_sleep_0
turtle-rabbit.text: 兔子想：它那么慢，怎么可能追上我？

turtle-rabbit.name: turtle_rabbit_sleep_1
turtle-rabbit.text: 我先在树下睡一觉，醒来再跑也来得及。

turtle-rabbit.name: turtle_rabbit_steady_0
turtle-rabbit.text: 乌龟不着急，也没有停下来休息。

turtle-rabbit.name: turtle_rabbit_steady_1
turtle-rabbit.text: 它只盯着前方，一步一步走向终点。

turtle-rabbit.name: turtle_rabbit_overtake_0
turtle-rabbit.text: 经过大树时，它看见了熟睡的兔子。

turtle-rabbit.name: turtle_rabbit_overtake_1
turtle-rabbit.text: 乌龟没有叫醒它，继续认真地向前走。

turtle-rabbit.name: turtle_rabbit_wake_0
turtle-rabbit.text: 过了好一会儿，兔子终于醒了。

turtle-rabbit.name: turtle_rabbit_wake_1
turtle-rabbit.text: 糟糕！乌龟快到终点了，它赶紧追过去。

turtle-rabbit.name: turtle_rabbit_finish_0
turtle-rabbit.text: 兔子拼命奔跑，可是已经来不及了。

turtle-rabbit.name: turtle_rabbit_finish_1
turtle-rabbit.text: 乌龟先到终点，小动物们欢呼起来。

turtle-rabbit.name: turtle_rabbit_moral_0
turtle-rabbit.text: 兔子低下头，承认自己太骄傲了。

turtle-rabbit.name: turtle_rabbit_moral_1
turtle-rabbit.text: 认真对待比赛，坚持到底，才能赢得胜利。

foolish-move-mountain.name: foolish_move_mountain_blocked_0
foolish-move-mountain.text: 愚公移山。

foolish-move-mountain.name: foolish_move_mountain_blocked_1
foolish-move-mountain.text: 太行和王屋两座大山，挡在愚公家门前。

foolish-move-mountain.name: foolish_move_mountain_plan_0
foolish-move-mountain.text: 每天出门，都要绕很远的路。

foolish-move-mountain.name: foolish_move_mountain_plan_1
foolish-move-mountain.text: 愚公召集家人，决定一起把山搬走。

foolish-move-mountain.name: foolish_move_mountain_question_0
foolish-move-mountain.text: 家人问：挖出的土石放到哪里？

foolish-move-mountain.name: foolish_move_mountain_question_1
foolish-move-mountain.text: 愚公说：我们把它运到渤海边去。

foolish-move-mountain.name: foolish_move_mountain_dig_0
foolish-move-mountain.text: 第二天，愚公带着儿孙来到山脚。

foolish-move-mountain.name: foolish_move_mountain_dig_1
foolish-move-mountain.text: 他们凿石头，挖泥土，认真干了起来。

foolish-move-mountain.name: foolish_move_mountain_carry_0
foolish-move-mountain.text: 挖出的土石，装进筐里运走。

foolish-move-mountain.name: foolish_move_mountain_carry_1
foolish-move-mountain.text: 路途很远，来回一趟要花很长时间。

foolish-move-mountain.name: foolish_move_mountain_doubt_0
foolish-move-mountain.text: 一个叫智叟的老人，笑他们太傻。

foolish-move-mountain.name: foolish_move_mountain_doubt_1
foolish-move-mountain.text: 你已经这么老了，怎么搬得完两座大山？

foolish-move-mountain.name: foolish_move_mountain_answer_0
foolish-move-mountain.text: 愚公说：我做不完，还有儿子。

foolish-move-mountain.name: foolish_move_mountain_answer_1
foolish-move-mountain.text: 儿子做不完，还有孙子，一代接一代。

foolish-move-mountain.name: foolish_move_mountain_generations_0
foolish-move-mountain.text: 子孙会不断延续，大山却不会再长高。

foolish-move-mountain.name: foolish_move_mountain_generations_1
foolish-move-mountain.text: 只要一直挖下去，总有一天能把路打开。

foolish-move-mountain.name: foolish_move_mountain_seasons_0
foolish-move-mountain.text: 寒来暑往，愚公一家始终没有放弃。

foolish-move-mountain.name: foolish_move_mountain_seasons_1
foolish-move-mountain.text: 他们的决心，终于感动了天帝。

foolish-move-mountain.name: foolish_move_mountain_divine_0
foolish-move-mountain.text: 天帝派来了两位力大无穷的神。

foolish-move-mountain.name: foolish_move_mountain_divine_1
foolish-move-mountain.text: 让他们帮助愚公，背走这两座大山。

foolish-move-mountain.name: foolish_move_mountain_lift_0
foolish-move-mountain.text: 两位神背起大山，把它们搬到了远方。

foolish-move-mountain.name: foolish_move_mountain_lift_1
foolish-move-mountain.text: 家门前，终于不再有大山挡路了。

foolish-move-mountain.name: foolish_move_mountain_moral_0
foolish-move-mountain.text: 愚公和家人，终于走上了宽阔的路。

foolish-move-mountain.name: foolish_move_mountain_moral_1
foolish-move-mountain.text: 认准目标，坚持不懈，就能改变眼前的困难。
